name: Vellichor
description: Self-hosted web app that turns your written stories and ebooks into narrated audiobooks using the Kokoro-82M TTS model. Multi-voice character casting, background ambience, chaptered M4B + per-chapter MP3 output, and auto-export to an Audiobookshelf library. Optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration (requires the Nvidia Driver plugin); falls back to CPU. Optional AI "Smart cast" needs a separate Ollama container — set Ollama URL below; without it the rule-based Quick detect is used.

paths.name: App data (/data)
paths.description: Accounts, each user's private library (users/name/), job history, and the model cache (Kokoro). Persisted.

paths.name: Audiobook library (/library)
paths.description: Optional. Where finished audiobooks are exported, e.g. your Audiobookshelf library share. Leave blank if unused.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Initial password for the admin account, applied on first start only (change it afterwards in the app: 👤 → Your password). LEAVE BLANK ONLY ON A TRUSTED LAN — blank disables sign-in entirely.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: Username for the admin account. Only used when the account list is first created. Other people are added from inside the app (👤 → People).

variables.name: Secret key
variables.description: Session-cookie signing key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Blank = a random key each restart (everyone gets logged out on restart).

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: Whose X-Forwarded-For header to believe when identifying a caller for login rate limiting. "private" (default) trusts loopback + LAN/Docker ranges, which is right when Vellichor is behind a reverse proxy. Use "none" if nothing proxies it, or list IPs/CIDRs. Wrong value = every visitor shares one lockout bucket, or the limit can be bypassed with a spoofed header.

variables.name: Login max failures
variables.description: Failed sign-ins before a caller is locked out.

variables.name: Login lockout seconds
variables.description: Length of the first lockout in seconds; it doubles with each further failure, up to 15 minutes.

variables.name: Ollama URL (AI Smart cast)
variables.description: Optional. URL of a separate Ollama container for AI Smart cast, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434. Blank disables Smart cast (rule-based Quick detect still works).

variables.name: Smart cast model
variables.description: Ollama model used for Smart cast (must be pulled in your Ollama container).

variables.name: Completion notify URL
variables.description: Optional ntfy/gotify URL to get a push when a conversion finishes.

variables.name: Export owner UID
variables.description: UID to own exported audiobook files so your library app can read them (Unraid 'nobody' = 99).

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: GPU(s) to expose. Requires the Nvidia Driver plugin. NO GPU? Clear 'Extra Parameters' (remove --runtime=nvidia) and ignore this.
